description: Streaming surfaces the spec gets wrong. (1) POST /completions streams with `stream: true` — its own `stream` member documents data-only server-sent events terminated by `data: [DONE]`, and the legacy Completions API has always streamed that way — but the 200 response lists only application/json, so no createCompletionStream is generated. Declare the text/event-stream content (each event is a CreateCompletionResponse chunk, as in the OpenAI reference). (2) POST /audio/speech lists text/event-stream next to the audio formats, but it streams SSE only when `stream_format: "sse"` is sent; there is no boolean `stream` flag to select it, so the generated event-stream sibling would request audio bytes and parse them as events. Drop the SSE content so createSpeech returns the audio bytes.
